channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Caris LeVert | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Caris LeVert from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ezra Ausar on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Ausar on LeVert's playmaking:

“He always says he’s the best passer on the team. I don’t know about that one, because I’m standing here.”

Ezra Ausar on Caris LeVert, Mar 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert's wrist injury:

“It happened last night, I believe, in the first half. He took a fall. He got images todayso I don’t have any more information. I haven’t heard what those images turned out just yet.”

JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert, Mar 8, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on JB Bickerstaff, Caris LeVert
item.description:
Coty M. Davis:Trajan Langdon on the addition of Caris LeVert:

“The special thing about Caris, you can plug and play him with just about everyone... I am confident that J.B. (Bickerstaff) is going to find a good role for him.”

Trajan Langdon on JB Bickerstaff, Caris LeVert, Jul 8, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert, who is out tonight with an ankle sprain:

“I talked to him last night and he said he was doing good. [...] But he's not in a boot or anything like that. He's in shoes. He's not on crutches. He's walking. So those are all good signs.”

JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert, Nov 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @kelseyyrusso.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Serena Winters:JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert:

“He’s an added weapon, that people have to make a decision on & they have to pick their poison...it makes us more dynamic on both ends of the floor. He’s a long rangy defender as well to go along with the size that we have.”

JB Bickerstaff on Caris LeVert, Feb 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Domantas Sabonis on Caris LeVert
item.description:
James Boyd:Domantas Sabonis on the Caris LeVert trade:

“We know it’s a business. It’s the NBA, trade deadline always gets crazy, especially if you don’t have a great record going on. We saw him in the locker room. It was pretty crazy that it was Cleveland and we were there already.”

Domantas Sabonis on Caris LeVert, Feb 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Caris LeVert
item.description:
#Pacers president Kevin Pritchard on knowing when they lost LeVert to cancer surgery:

“We knew we were going to have some struggles. Winning masks some issues. When you lose, sometimes it exacerbates some issues.”

Kevin Pritchard on Caris LeVert, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: TJ McConnell on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Scott Agness:T.J. McConnell on Caris LeVert:

“He’s an amazing teammate, fits amazing into this locker room. “He’s opened up the floor for all of us and when we need a timely bucket and a big bucket, he goes out and gets it for us.”

TJ McConnell on Caris LeVert, Mar 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Steve Nash on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Tony East:Steve Nash on coaching against Caris LeVert:

“Caris is incredibly loved in our locker room and in our organization. He's a world class guy... We love the guy and hopes that he has a heck of a career. I'll be happy to see him out there on the court tonight.”

Steve Nash on Caris LeVert, Mar 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @TEastNBA.

item.title: Michael Malone on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Malone:

“I'm a big fan of Caris LeVert, as a young man, as a player..he can get to anywhere he wants on the court.”

Michael Malone on Caris LeVert, Mar 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on Caris LeVert
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Bjorkgren on LeVert:

“Not officially been cleared yet, to me anyway.... I have not had any conversations about minutes with him bc I haven't been given the green light he's going to play.”

Nate Bjorkgren on Caris LeVert, Mar 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Domantas Sabonis on Caris LeVert
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Sabonis on what it was like practicing with LeVert:

“He looked great. Looked confident. ...In the pick-and-roll, going downhill. .. He's going to attract a lot of defense to him,creating open shots for everybody. I feel like that's what we've been missing.”

Domantas Sabonis on Caris LeVert, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Caris LeVert
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Brogdon on how LeVert looked at practice:

“He looks good. To me he looks ready to play.... He changes the scouting report.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Caris LeVert, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on Caris LeVert
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Bjorkgren on Caris LeVert's progress:

“He's getting involved a lot.... He was in 4 on 0 offense. 5 on 0 offense. All of our shooting drills are non-contact drills and he was in every one of them.”

Nate Bjorkgren on Caris LeVert, Feb 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Tony East:More Pritchard on a LeVert timeline:

“We will know more in the next 7 days... maybe 6 to 8 weeks he's picking up a basketball.”

Kevin Pritchard on Caris LeVert, Jan 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @TEastNBA.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Eric Woodyard:Pacers president of basketball operations Kevin Pritchard on status of Caris LeVert:

“As soon as we found this out, all eyes were trying to help Caris.”

Kevin Pritchard on Caris LeVert, Jan 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Michael Malone on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving, Caris LeVert, Joe Harris
item.description:
Malone on the Nets:

“Kevin Durant, the guy is virtually unguardable... Caris LeVert, since Kyrie Irving has been gone, is playing at an incredibly high level. Joe Harris seems to never miss. Jarred Allen playing at a high level.”

Michael Malone on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving, Caris LeVert, Joe Harris, Jan 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Alex Schiffer:Brad Stevens on Caris LeVert:

“He’s one of the young guards in the league that has continuously gotten better.”

Brad Stevens on Caris LeVert, Mar 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @Alex__Schiffer.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Kenny Atkinson on LeVert’s return:

“We need that energy boost right now. I don’t see us playing like a super-high energy team right now.”

Kenny Atkinson on Caris LeVert, Jan 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Kenny Atkinson on LeVert:

“I feel bad for Caris. It’s bad luck, especially with what he went through last year. I feel for him. And obviously it’s a big blow for us; our 2nd-leading scorer, probably our best perimeter defender on that first squad, first unit. Big hit.”

Kenny Atkinson on Caris LeVert, Nov 14, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Sean Marks on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Bryan Kalbrosky:Brooklyn Nets GM Sean Marks on his initial reaction to the Caris LeVert injury:

“I’m not sure you can print that or put it into words.”

Sean Marks on Caris LeVert, Nov 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @BryanKalbrosky.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Celtics:Gordon Hayward on Caris LeVert’s injury:

“I know first-hand what it’s like. If he wants to reach out, he knows how to get a hold of me.”

Gordon Hayward on Caris LeVert, Nov 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Russell, who recently tweeted,

“Kinda hard for me to say this because he’s a Michigan guy, but all jokes aside Caris LeVert got better,”

D'Angelo Russell on Caris LeVert, Sep 28, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: DeMarre Carroll on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Brian Lewis:DeMarre Carroll on his reaction to seeing Caris LeVert go down:

“You know how when you’re a father and something happens to your kid at daycare? I was fixing to get thrown out.”

DeMarre Carroll on Caris LeVert, Feb 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Caris LeVert
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Atkinson on LeVert:

“We want to bring him along intelligently, grow him. He’s pushing for more minutes & its something we’ll look at”

Kenny Atkinson on Caris LeVert, Jan 17, 2017. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.
